name: spellkave_events
label: Spellkave Events
description: Read recent Spellkave world events from the SDK snapshot. The `spellkave_events` tool no longer lists another session's session lifecycle, in-session frame, turn-boundary, or action-economy header rows for unrelated plain players; participants and callers with an extent grant that covers a participant still see those rows.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent events to read.
